test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘RAJESH’ is written as ‘IUHNFX’, and ‘GARIMA’ is written as ‘BOLVFM’. How will ‘RITIKA’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

‘RAJESH’ is written as ‘IUHNFX’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2fb077181b5366e0eee352110ae381e42d57f790fe8168f02fe7c252dcf4623.png] 

And,

GARIMA’ is written as ‘BOLVFM’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f858902d953c2acef58d7c9401d2cffe482d3b84e5266a016e41d90a6e8aae9e.png] 

Similarly,

‘RITIKA’ be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbc6e4816b64695d724eb98386d2f07c610200527c8884b2bf56520fb66b9ef5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"BMLXNX".**
